patterns.what_worked: Per-branch reads of the mirror with explicit path:line for every claim; whole-tree sweeps plus the generated API docs for the two absence-shaped questions (GameTooltipStatusBar, InspectGuildFrame_Update); the sibling-declaration trick ( -> GameTooltipTextLeft1) turned an unverifiable absence into a sourced, branch-qualified correction.
patterns.what_was_hard: Q3 could not be closed to VERIFIED: the XML loader is engine C++, so 'a named $parent <Frames> child becomes a Lua global' could only be proven for a <Layers> sibling. Every <Frames> case I could resolve to a concrete name (MirrorTimer1/2/3) is referenced nowhere in the tree, so the step stays ASSUMED and is written as such.
patterns.skill_gap: A python sweep over the whole XML tree to resolve every $parent child to a concrete global timed out at 120s and was abandoned; a bounded, per-file approach worked but cost several round trips.
